summary: One-hand basketball dunk: airborne with the right arm fully extended, ball above the rim in the right hand, wrist snapping down, left arm out for balance, right knee raised.

environment.text: Rim 3.05 m high (inner diameter 45 cm, about twice the ball); ball {up:ball:rim} cm above the rim, fingertips {up:r_fingertip:rim} cm above it; backboard behind the rim.

cameras.name: under_rim
cameras.text: From below the rim looking up, backboard and arena lights behind, extreme perspective.

cameras.name: side
cameras.text: Profile: the arm above the rim and the raised knee.

cameras.name: wide_cinema
cameras.text: Wide cinematic frame from the key, crowd rising behind.

rules.why: hand clearly above the rim (dunk contestants reach about 55 cm above it)
ball above the rim before being thrown down
dunking arm extended (estimate from technique descriptions)
high vertical jump (about 0.8-1.0 m in dunkers)

text.action: a basketball player throwing down a one-hand dunk, ball above the rim
text.core: Airborne high above the floor; right arm fully extended overhead, ball palmed in the right hand just above the rim, wrist flexing to push it down through the hoop; left arm out to the side for balance; right knee raised, left leg hanging with toes pointed; trunk slightly arched.
cues: hand above the rim, fingers spread over the ball
rim at about 1.6 times the player's height
kinetic: camera flashes in the crowd, sweat flying
avoid: ball too big or small for the rim
rim at the wrong height for the player

sources.cite: Tong & Wang 2024, PLoS ONE: NBA dunk contest participants, standing reach 258-268 cm, max vertical 95-102 cm
